# Bright Blue

> Bright Blue Trading Corporation — home care, personal care and food products,
> manufactured in Kerala, India since 2019. International Book of Records
> holder for the maximum number of fragrance variants created for a
> dishwashing liquid brand (MX-3, 24 fragrances), awarded to Mr Faisal V.K.

Every page below is server-rendered — the HTML returned on first request
already contains the real content, not a client-side shell.

## Store

- [Shop the full catalogue](/shop)
- [Search](/search)
- [Our story](/story)
- [Where to buy](/stockists)
- [Full product sitemap](/sitemap.xml) — every brand, category, product and
  combo currently published, kept current on the same 60-second cadence as
  the pages themselves.

## Notes for automated readers

- Prices shown are GST-inclusive, in Indian Rupees. A product with no price
  yet reads "Price on request" — never a placeholder ₹0.00.
- `/admin` is a staff-only management panel, not part of the public catalogue,
  and is excluded from indexing.
